findings.issue: The empty-state copy 'No activities match. Choose a longer time or another theme.' leaves out format, even though format is one of the three active filters and can cause zero results alone.
findings.fix: Use 'No activities match these filters.' and let the Clear filters button handle recovery.

findings.issue: The first printed page mixes spellings: US 'neighborhood' and 'colored' alongside UK 'neighbours' and 'Organiser'. Unslop standards call for one consistent voice.
findings.fix: Pick one locale for guide copy and normalize these strings.

findings.issue: The paragraph after the numbered steps ('Four colored cards…') runs nearly the full page width. Surrounding paragraphs are held to a narrower measure, so the line length looks inconsistent and harder to read.
findings.fix: Apply the same max-width measure to that paragraph in print.

findings.issue: On phone, '180 minutes' wraps alone onto a full-width second row. Because it is also the selected state, it looks like a primary action rather than one of four equal options.
findings.fix: Use a 2x2 grid for the tabs at narrow widths so all four route buttons are equal-sized.

visualScope: Reviewed four browser screenshots: filtered menu on desktop and phone (Clear filters visibility, filter state restored, count text), the 180-minute route selected on phone, and the first printed-guide page. I also read navigation.js, library.js and routes.js for concrete defects. I found no blocking navigation bug. Query validation, the host override precedence, same-origin/file:// handling, the replaceState fallback and link re-syncing after render all read correctly. No physical print output was assessed.
